title: WarmSet@1 payload
description: The exact per-node set of carried layers one Round's Attempts start from, selected before the first AttemptDispatched@1 and listed in every Attempt's context manifest. Notes and the Head Delta come only from the previous closed Round's admitted Attempt of the same node; fenced, quarantined, malformed and released Attempts contribute nothing. A retry inherits the Round's Warm Set, never its failed sibling's state. A Head Delta over its bound is dropped at selection with a recorded reason, so no renderer can refuse an already selected Warm Set. Package P2 adds the build cache layer: the explicitly unsafe BuildCache@1 this Round's Gate captured, carried Gate to Worker within the same Round under the trusted-local policy only, or a recorded drop reason. Package P3 adds the Warm Workspace: the opaque identity of the node's stable template root within the Campaign and the basis on which it holds this Round's head (materialized in full, re-based by tree diff with digest verification, or reused unchanged). Package P4 adds the session layer: the SessionSnapshot@1 of the same source Attempt, selected only when the adapter supports a forked resume, the capture's cleanup completed, the Attempt is younger than warm.session.max_age and the transcript fits the reservation beside the delta prompt; every other outcome is a recorded drop and the Attempt runs on Notes alone.

head_delta_dropped.description: Recorded when the Round's Head Delta was computed but exceeded its bound; never present beside head_delta_artifact_id.

build_cache_artifact_id.description: The review.kernel/BuildCache@1 this Round's Gate captured for the kind the node declares. Explicitly unsafe; never a Cache Snapshot.

build_cache_dropped.description: Recorded when the node declared a build cache kind and none was carried; never present beside build_cache_artifact_id.

workspace.description: How the node's stable workspace template came to hold this Round's head. Present exactly with workspace_id; absent for a node that templates fresh per Round.

workspace_id.description: The opaque identity of the node's stable workspace root within this Campaign. Never a host path.

session_artifact_id.description: The review.kernel/SessionSnapshot@1 the source Attempt left, re-materialized and resumed forked so the captured transcript is never mutated.

session_dropped.description: Recorded when the node's policy asked for the session layer and none was carried; never present beside session_artifact_id.
